integrity: Self-contained mathematical argument and a bounded direct-enumeration/transfer-matrix verification script; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact for every q>=2, k>=1 with a fixed linear host consisting of k repetitions of an increasing permutation on q labeled symbols. Top-three-layer formula assumes q>=3, k>=3. Does not cover arbitrary blocks or rotations of the host. Finite checks do not replace proof; unindexed prior equivalents cannot be ruled out.
title: Rotation-complete scattered-subsequence necklaces of repeated permutation words
